 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    INSERT INTO contour.sources (tenant_id,source_id,collector_id,project_id,service_id,environment_id,deployment_id,source_nonce,binding_mode)
        VALUES (tenant,source,collector,project,service,environment,deployment,nonce,'instance');

        (tenant,source,collector,project,service,environment,deployment,instance);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.valid_parser_profiles(profiles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT coalesce(pg_catalog.array_ndims(profiles) = 1 AND pg_catalog.cardinality(profiles) BETWEEN 1 AND 128
        AND pg_catalog.cardinality(profiles) = (SELECT pg_catalog.count(DISTINCT name) FROM pg_catalog.unnest(profiles) name)
        AND (SELECT pg_catalog.bool_and(name IS NOT NULL AND name COLLATE "C" ~ '^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$')
            FROM pg_catalog.unnest(profiles) name), false)
$function$
value.name: valid_parser_profiles

value.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.valid_catalog_reasons(reasons text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
    SELECT coalesce(cardinality(reasons)<=8
        AND (cardinality(reasons)=0 OR array_ndims(reasons)=1)
        AND cardinality(reasons)=(SELECT count(DISTINCT reason) FROM unnest(reasons) reason)
        AND reasons <@ ARRAY['permission','encrypted','unsupported','sampled','limit',
            'malformed','source_gap','clock_skew']::text[],false)
$function$
value.name: valid_catalog_reasons

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.check_review_decision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'contour'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.decision='approve' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM contour.review_requests r JOIN contour.approval_events e
            ON e.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND e.event_id=NEW.approval_event_id
        WHERE r.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND r.review_id=NEW.review_id
            AND e.operation_id=r.operation_id AND e.project_id=r.project_id
            AND e.service_id=r.service_id AND e.environment_id=r.environment_id
            AND e.version_id=r.candidate_version_id AND e.actor_id=NEW.actor_id
            AND e.expected_event_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.expected_event_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'decision approval association does not match review' USING ERRCODE='23503';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
value.name: check_review_decision

value.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.check_review_request()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'contour'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM contour.tenant_context() THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'review tenant context required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contour.comparisons c
        WHERE c.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND c.comparison_id=NEW.comparison_id
        AND c.operation_id=NEW.operation_id AND c.project_id=NEW.project_id
        AND c.service_id=NEW.service_id AND c.environment_id=NEW.environment_id
        AND c.right_kind='declared' AND c.right_version_id=NEW.candidate_version_id
        AND ((NEW.expected_event_id IS NULL AND c.left_kind='declared')
            OR (c.left_kind='approved' AND c.left_event_id=NEW.expected_event_id))) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'review inputs do not match comparison' USING ERRCODE='23503';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
value.name: check_review_request

AS $function$
BEGIN

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.lock_origin_collector(tenant uuid, collector uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF collector IS NULL OR NOT pg_catalog.pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(contour.collector_lock_key(tenant,collector)) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'collector gate busy' USING ERRCODE='40001';
    END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.origin_history_highwater(tenant uuid, lifecycle uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE highwater timestamptz;
BEGIN
    PERFORM contour.require_origin_locks(tenant,NULL,NULL);
    SELECT max(m.at_time) INTO highwater FROM (
        SELECT l.enrolled_at AS at_time FROM contour.origin_lifecycles l
          WHERE l.tenant_id=tenant AND l.lifecycle_id=lifecycle
        UNION ALL
        SELECT c.enrolled_at FROM contour.origin_credentials c
          WHERE c.tenant_id=tenant AND c.lifecycle_id=lifecycle
        UNION ALL
        SELECT g.granted_at FROM contour.origin_observer_grants g
          WHERE g.tenant_id=tenant AND g.lifecycle_id=lifecycle
        UNION ALL
        SELECT e.event_at FROM contour.origin_terminal_events e
          WHERE e.tenant_id=tenant AND e.lifecycle_id=lifecycle AND e.event_kind='lifecycle_closed'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT e.event_at FROM contour.origin_credentials c JOIN contour.origin_terminal_events e
          ON e.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND e.credential_id=c.credential_id AND e.event_kind='credential_revoked'
          WHERE c.tenant_id=tenant AND c.lifecycle_id=lifecycle
        UNION ALL
        SELECT e.event_at FROM contour.origin_observer_grants g JOIN contour.origin_terminal_events e
          ON e.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND e.grant_id=g.grant_id AND e.event_kind='grant_revoked'
          WHERE g.tenant_id=tenant AND g.lifecycle_id=lifecycle
    ) m;
    RETURN highwater;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION contour.require_instance_binding()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF NEW.binding_mode='instance' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM contour.source_instance_bindings b
        WHERE b.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND b.source_id=NEW.source_id) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'instance source requires binding in same transaction' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NULL;
END $function$
